revenueModel.text: The Company earns revenue from selling apparel to customers through its wholesale, in-store and online channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Each of our brands serve or are expected to serve customers through our wholesale, in store and online channels, allowing us to execute on our omni-channel strategy.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company expanded into collegiate-branded apparel through exclusive private label manufacturing agreements with AAA Tuscaloosa, Traffic Holdco and The Grove Collective.
changes.evidence: Under these agreements, the Company manufactures collegiate-branded apparel for distribution through university channels and related platforms.
